questions.prompt: Which truth-table output column represents F in row order FFF, FFT, FTF, FTT, TFF, TFT, TTF, TTT?
questions.context: Let F = ((p → q) ∧ (q → r) ∧ ¬r). Variables p, q, r are propositions; → is material implication and ⊕ is exclusive OR.
hints: An implication is false only for a true antecedent and a false consequent. Evaluate inner connectives first.
State the domain and all hypotheses explicitly. Work out the result before comparing the four choices.

explanation.learning_objective: Distinguish equivalence, satisfiability, implication, and conditional model counts.
